summary: Observe Error.prototype.toString property lookup and coercion in name-before-message order.

semantics.abrupt: an abrupt operation stops later lookups

tests.name: getter order
tests.input: let s=[]; const o={get name(){s.push('n');return 'N'},get message(){s.push('m');return 'M'}}; Error.prototype.toString.call(o); console.log(s.join(','))

tests.name: name coercion throw skips message
tests.input: let hit=false; const o={name:{toString(){throw 1}},get message(){hit=true}}; try{Error.prototype.toString.call(o)}catch(e){} console.log(hit)
